title: CIA-UAP-019, Australian Dept of Defense Scientific and Intel Aspects of the UFO Problem
doc_notes: This is a CIA-sourced Australian Department of Defense intelligence document analyzing the history of U.S. UFO projects, which contains brief summaries of specific encounter reports.
